name: Hubei Zhongyi Technology Inc.
summary: Hubei Zhongyi Technology Inc. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of various single- and double-sided high-performance electrolytic copper foil products in China. The company offers electronic circuit copper foil and lithium battery-ion copper foil products. Its products are used in new energy vehicle power batteries, energy storage equipment, electronic products, copper-clad laminates, printed circuit boards, and other applications. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Xiaogan, China.
